game.title: Bulletstorm: Full Clip Edition
game.build_notes: Verified 2026-09-17 on RTX (home PC, 3440x1440 desktop): started StormGame-Win64-Shipping.exe directly windowed; main menu background after ~45 s; closed with WM_CLOSE. The game ships StormGame-Win64-Shipping.pdb - full symbols.

states.name: main_menu_background
states.detect: Main menu background scene about 45 s after start, showing the Steam account name.

steps: start <game>\Binaries\Win64\StormGame-Win64-Shipping.exe directly with the arguments -windowed ResX=1280 ResY=720
PostMessage WM_CLOSE to the game's top-level window

config_files: The user config would live under Documents\My Games\Bulletstorm Full Clip Edition\ (MyDocumentsSubDirName in DefaultEngine.ini); the shipped StormGame\Config\Steamworks\SteamworksSystemSettings.ini forces FullScreen=true [inferred-static 2026-09-17].
entry_points.proxy_dll: dxgi.dll beside the exe; log shows CreateDXGIFactory, CompatValue, CreateDXGIFactory1 [verified-live 2026-09-17, n=1].
entry_points.window: FullScreen=False, ResX=1280, ResY=720 in Documents\My Games\Bulletstorm Full Clip Edition\StormGame\Config\StormSystemSettings.ini. The ResX/ResY command-line switches are ignored when that file says otherwise (came up 1850x1041 on a 1920x1080 screen); with the file set, client 1280x720 and the screen unchanged [measured 2026-10-06, n=1].

routes.how: Enter at the title, Space (autosave notice), Space (Campaign), Space (Continue), wait about 40 s, Space (chapter card).

Esc opens the pause menu; Down x5 to EXIT TO MAIN MENU (verify the highlight: after visiting Options the cursor does not restart at the top); Space; Space to confirm. At the main menu Up x1 wraps to QUIT; Space; Space to confirm.

hazards.hazard: Launched through Steam it runs fullscreen and minimises when it loses focus
hazards.notes: A firewall prompt stole focus and the game minimised. Start the exe directly with -windowed.

hazards.hazard: A Windows Firewall prompt on the first run steals focus
hazards.notes: A Windows Defender Firewall 'allow access' dialog appeared on the first launch on this machine and took focus from the game. The main session pressed Cancel; answering it is left to the user. Losing focus can minimise a fullscreen game.

hazards.hazard: Music volume is stored only in the packed, Steam-Cloud-synced profile.bin, not in any ini
hazards.notes: Set it in Options > Audio > Music Volume instead (Left x25 reaches zero) [verified-live 2026-10-06].

hazards.hazard: The pause-menu cursor position is not reset after returning from Options; blind key counts land on Restart Chapter

api_notes: SendInput with SCANCODES works; keybd_event with virtual-key codes does nothing [verified-live 2026-10-06].
Enter 0x1C, Space 0x39, Esc 0x01; arrows need the extended flag (Up E0 48, Down E0 50, Left E0 4B); numpad 4/5/6 = 0x4B/0x4C/0x4D.
